title: Zork1: graph-paper map as text, a square is two characters wide

1.name: West of House
1.desc: You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded front door. A secret path leads southwest into the forest.

exits.msg: The door is boarded and you can't remove the boards.

2.name: North of House
2.desc:
You are facing the north side of a white house. There is no door here,
and all the windows are boarded up. To the north a narrow path winds through
the trees.

exits.msg: The windows are all boarded.

3.name: South of House
3.desc:
You are facing the south side of a white house. There is no door here,
and all the windows are boarded.

exits.msg: The windows are all boarded.

4.name: Forest
4.desc:
This is a forest, with trees in all directions. To the east,
there appears to be sunlight.

exits.msg: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.
You would need a machete to go further west.

5.name: Stone Barrow
5.desc:
You are standing in front of a massive barrow of stone. In the east face
is a huge stone door which is open. You cannot see into the dark of the tomb.

6.name: Behind House
6.desc: You are behind the white house. A path leads into the forest to the east. In one corner of the house there is a small window which is open. slightly ajar.

7.name: Forest Path
7.desc:
This is a path winding through a dimly lit forest. The path heads
north-south here. One particularly large tree with some low branches
stands at the edge of the path.

8.name: Forest
8.desc: This is a dimly lit forest, with large trees all around.

exits.msg: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.
The rank undergrowth prevents eastward movement.
Storm-tossed trees block your way.

9.name: Clearing
9.desc: You are in a clearing, with a forest surrounding you on all sides. A path leads south. There is an open grating, descending into darkness. There is a grating securely fastened into the ground.

exits.msg: The forest becomes impenetrable to the north.

10.name: Clearing
10.desc:
You are in a small clearing in a well marked forest path that
extends to the east and west.

exits.msg: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.

11.name: Forest
11.desc: This is a dimly lit forest, with large trees all around.

exits.msg: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.
The forest becomes impenetrable to the north.

12.name: Up a Tree
12.desc: You are about 10 feet above the ground nestled among some large branches. The nearest branch above you is above your reach. On the ground below you can see: .

exits.msg: You cannot climb any higher.

13.name: Canyon View
13.desc:
You are at the top of the Great Canyon on its west wall. From here
there is a marvelous view of the canyon and parts of the Frigid River
upstream. Across the canyon, the walls of the White Cliffs join the
mighty ramparts of the Flathead Mountains to the east. Following the
Canyon upstream to the north, Aragain Falls may be seen, complete with
rainbow. The mighty Frigid River flows out from a great dark cavern. To
the west and south can be seen an immense forest, stretching for miles
around. A path leads northwest. It is possible to climb down into
the canyon from here.

exits.msg: Storm-tossed trees block your way.

14.name: Grating Room
14.desc: You are in a small room near the maze. There are twisty passages in the immediate vicinity. Above you is an open grating with sunlight pouring in. Above you is a grating. Above you is a grating locked with a skull-and-crossbones lock.

exits.msg: The grating is closed.

15.name: Forest
15.desc: The forest thins out, revealing impassable mountains.

exits.msg: The mountains are impassable.
The mountains are impassable.

16.name: Rocky Ledge
16.desc:
You are on a ledge about halfway up the wall of the river canyon.
You can see from here that the main flow from Aragain Falls twists
along a passage which it is impossible for you to enter. Below you is the
canyon bottom. Above you is more cliff, which appears
climbable.

17.name: Canyon Bottom
17.desc:
You are beneath the walls of the river canyon which may be climbable
here. The lesser part of the runoff of Aragain Falls flows by below.
To the north is a narrow path.

18.name: End of Rainbow
18.desc:
You are on a small, rocky beach on the continuation of the Frigid
River past the Falls. The beach is narrow due to the presence of the
White Cliffs. The river canyon opens here and sunlight shines in
from above. A rainbow crosses over the falls to the east and a narrow
path continues to the southwest.

19.name: On the Rainbow
19.desc:
You are on top of a rainbow (I bet you never thought you would walk
on a rainbow), with a magnificent view of the Falls. The rainbow
travels east-west here.

20.name: Aragain Falls
20.desc: You are at the top of Aragain Falls, an enormous waterfall with a drop of about 450 feet. The only path here is on the north end. A solid rainbow spans the falls. A beautiful rainbow can be seen over the falls and to the west.

exits.msg: It's a long way...

21.name: Shore
21.desc:
You are on the east shore of the river. The water here seems somewhat
treacherous. A path travels from north to south here, the south end
quickly turning around a sharp corner.

22.name: Kitchen
22.desc: You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open. slightly ajar.

exits.msg: Only Santa Claus climbs down chimneys.

23.name: Attic
23.desc: This is the attic. The only exit is a stairway leading down.

24.name: Studio
24.desc:
This appears to have been an artist's studio. The walls and floors are
splattered with paints of 69 different colors. Strangely enough, nothing
of value is hanging here. At the south end of the room is an open door
(also covered with paint). A dark and narrow chimney leads up from a
fireplace; although you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely
you could get back down.

25.name: Living Room
25.desc: You are in the living room. There is a doorway to the east . To the west is a cyclops-shaped opening in an old wooden door, above which is some strange gothic lettering, , a wooden door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be nailed shut, a trophy case, and a rug lying beside an open trap door. and a closed trap door at your feet. and an open trap door at your feet. and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.

exits.msg: The door is nailed shut.

26.name: Strange Passage
26.desc:
This is a long passage. To the west is one entrance. On the
east there is an old wooden door, with a large opening in it (about
cyclops sized).

27.name: Cyclops Room
27.desc: This room has an exit on the northwest, and a staircase leading up. The cyclops is sleeping blissfully at the foot of the stairs. The east wall, previously solid, now has a cyclops-sized opening in it. A cyclops, who looks prepared to eat horses (much less mere adventurers), blocks the staircase. From his state of health, and the bloodstains on the walls, you gather that he is not very friendly, though he likes people. The cyclops is standing in the corner, eyeing you closely. I don't think he likes you very much. He looks extremely hungry, even for a cyclops. The cyclops, having eaten the hot peppers, appears to be gasping. His enflamed tongue protrudes from his man-sized mouth.

exits.msg: The east wall is solid rock.
The cyclops doesn't look like he'll let you past.

28.name: Treasure Room
28.desc:
This is a large room, whose east wall is solid granite. A number
of discarded bags, which crumble at your touch, are scattered about
on the floor. There is an exit down a staircase.

29.name: Cellar
29.desc: You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

exits.msg: You try to ascend the ramp, but it is impossible, and you slide back down.

30.name: East of Chasm
30.desc:
You are on the east edge of a chasm, the bottom of which cannot be
seen. A narrow passage goes north, and the path you are on continues
to the east.

exits.msg: The chasm probably leads straight to the infernal regions.

31.name: Slide Room
31.desc:
This is a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage, and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. To the north is
a small opening.

32.name: Cold Passage
32.desc:
This is a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
turns into a southward path.

33.name: Mine Entrance
33.desc:
You are standing at the entrance of what might have been a coal mine.
The shaft enters the west wall, and there is another exit on the south
end of the room.

34.name: Mirror Room
34.desc: You are in a large square room with tall ceilings. On the south wall is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall. There are exits on the other three sides of the room. Unfortunately, the mirror has been destroyed by your recklessness.

35.name: Squeaky Room
35.desc:
You are in a small room. Strange squeaky sounds may be heard coming
from the passage at the north end. You may also escape to the east.

36.name: Twisting Passage
36.desc:
This is a winding passage. It seems that there are only exits
on the east and north.

37.name: Cave
37.desc:
This is a tiny cave with entrances west and north, and a staircase
leading down.

38.name: Bat Room
38.desc: You are in a small room which has doors only to the east and south.

39.name: Atlantis Room
39.desc:
This is an ancient room, long under water. There is an exit to
the south and a staircase leading up.

40.name: Shaft Room
40.desc:
This is a large room, in the middle of which is a small shaft
descending through the floor into darkness below. To the west and
the north are exits from this room. Constructed over the top of the
shaft is a metal framework to which a heavy iron chain is attached.

exits.msg: You wouldn't fit and would die if you could.

41.name: Reservoir North
41.desc: You are in a large cavernous room, the south of which was formerly a lake. However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream running through there. You are in a large cavernous area. To the south is a wide lake, whose water level appears to be falling rapidly. You are in a cavernous area, to the south of which is a very wide stream. The level of the stream is rising rapidly, and it appears that before long it will be impossible to cross to the other side. You are in a large cavernous room, north of a large lake. There is a slimy stairway leaving the room to the north.

exits.msg: You would drown.

42.name: Smelly Room
42.desc:
This is a small nondescript room. However, from the direction
of a small descending staircase a foul odor can be detected. To the
south is a narrow tunnel.

43.name: Reservoir
43.desc: You are on what used to be a large lake, but which is now a large mud pile. There are "shores" to the north and south. You are on the lake. Beaches can be seen north and south. Upstream a small stream enters the lake through a narrow cleft in the rocks. The dam can be seen downstream.

exits.msg: The dam blocks your way.

44.name: Gas Room
44.desc:
This is a small room which smells strongly of coal gas. There is a
short climb up some stairs and a narrow tunnel leading east.

45.name: Reservoir South
45.desc: You are in a long room, to the north of which was formerly a lake. However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream running through the center of the room. You are in a long room. To the north is a large lake, too deep to cross. You notice, however, that the water level appears to be dropping at a rapid rate. Before long, it might be possible to cross to the other side from here. You are in a long room, to the north of which is a wide area which was formerly a reservoir, but now is merely a stream. You notice, however, that the level of the stream is rising quickly and that before long it will be impossible to cross here. You are in a long room on the south shore of a large lake, far too deep and wide for crossing. There is a path along the stream to the east or west, a steep pathway climbing southwest along the edge of a chasm, and a path leading into a canyon to the southeast.

exits.msg: You would drown.

46.name: Stream
46.desc:
You are on the gently flowing stream. The upstream route is too narrow
to navigate, and the downstream route is invisible due to twisting
walls. There is a narrow beach to land on.

exits.msg: The channel is too narrow.
The channel is too narrow.

47.name: Coal Mine
47.desc: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.

48.name: Deep Canyon
48.desc: You are on the south edge of a deep canyon. Passages lead off to the east, northwest and southwest. A stairway leads down. You can hear a loud roaring sound, like that of rushing water, from below. You can hear the sound of flowing water from below.

49.name: Chasm
49.desc:
A chasm runs southwest to northeast and the path follows it. You are
on the south side of the chasm, where a crack opens into a passage.

exits.msg: Are you out of your mind?

50.name: Dam
50.desc: You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to the north, south, and west, and a scramble down. The water level behind the dam is low: The sluice gates have been opened. Water rushes through the dam and downstream. The sluice gates are open, and water rushes through the dam. The water level behind the dam is still high. The sluice gates are closed. The water level in the reservoir is quite low, but the level is rising quickly. The sluice gates on the dam are closed. Behind the dam, there can be seen a wide reservoir. Water is pouring over the top of the now abandoned dam. There is a control panel here, on which a large metal bolt is mounted. Directly above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble which is glowing serenely .

51.name: Stream View
51.desc:
You are standing on a path beside a gently flowing stream. The path
follows the stream, which flows from west to east.

exits.msg: The stream emerges from a spot too small for you to enter.

52.name: Coal Mine
52.desc: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.

53.name: North-South Passage
53.desc: This is a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.

54.name: Loud Room
54.desc: This is a large room with a ceiling which cannot be detected from the ground. There is a narrow passage from east to west and a stone stairway leading upward. The room is eerie in its quietness. The room is deafeningly loud with an undetermined rushing sound. The sound seems to reverberate from all of the walls, making it difficult even to think.

55.name: East-West Passage
55.desc:
This is a narrow east-west passageway. There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.

56.name: Dam Base
56.desc:
You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3, which looms above you
and to the north. The river Frigid is flowing by here. Along the
river are the White Cliffs which seem to form giant walls stretching
from north to south along the shores of the river as it winds its
way downstream.

57.name: Dam Lobby
57.desc:
This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam. There are open doorways here to the north and east marked
"Private", and there is a path leading south over the top of the dam.

58.name: Coal Mine
58.desc: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.

59.name: Round Room
59.desc:
This is a circular stone room with passages in all directions. Several
of them have unfortunately been blocked by cave-ins.

60.name: Damp Cave
60.desc:
This cave has exits to the west and east, and narrows to a crack toward
the south. The earth is particularly damp here.

exits.msg: It is too narrow for most insects.

61.name: The Troll Room
61.desc:
This is a small room with passages to the east and south and a
forbidding hole leading west. Bloodstains and deep scratches
(perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.

exits.msg: The troll fends you off with a menacing gesture.
The troll fends you off with a menacing gesture.

62.name: Maintenance Room
62.desc:
This is what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3. Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for
most of the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
group of buttons colored blue, yellow, brown, and red. There are doorways to
the west and south.

63.name: Coal Mine
63.desc: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.

64.name: Narrow Passage
64.desc:
This is a long and narrow corridor where a long north-south passageway
briefly narrows even further.

65.name: Engravings Cave
65.desc: You have entered a low cave with passages leading northwest and east.

66.name: White Cliffs Beach
66.desc:
You are on a narrow strip of beach which runs along the base of the
White Cliffs. There is a narrow path heading south along the Cliffs
and a tight passage leading west into the cliffs themselves.

exits.msg: The path is too narrow.
The path is too narrow.

67.name: Ladder Top
67.desc:
This is a very small room. In the corner is a rickety wooden
ladder, leading downward. It might be safe to descend. There is
also a staircase leading upward.

68.name: Mirror Room
68.desc: You are in a large square room with tall ceilings. On the south wall is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall. There are exits on the other three sides of the room. Unfortunately, the mirror has been destroyed by your recklessness.

69.name: Dome Room
69.desc: You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling of another room below. Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a wooden railing which circles the dome. Hanging down from the railing is a rope which ends about ten feet from the floor below.

exits.msg: You cannot go down without fracturing many bones.

70.name: White Cliffs Beach
70.desc:
You are on a rocky, narrow strip of beach beside the Cliffs. A
narrow path leads north along the shore.

exits.msg: The path is too narrow.

71.name: Ladder Bottom
71.desc:
This is a rather wide room. On one side is the bottom of a
narrow wooden ladder. To the west and the south are passages
leaving the room.

72.name: Winding Passage
72.desc:
This is a winding passage. It seems that there are only exits
on the east and north.

73.name: Cave
73.desc:
This is a tiny cave with entrances west and north, and a dark,
forbidding staircase leading down.

74.name: Torch Room
74.desc: This is a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down staircase. Above you is a large dome. Up around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the center of the room sits a white marble pedestal. A piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some five feet above your head.

exits.msg: You cannot reach the rope.

75.name: Frigid River
75.desc:
The river is running faster here and the sound ahead appears to be
that of rushing water. On the east shore is a sandy beach. A small
area of beach can also be seen below the cliffs on the west shore.

exits.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.
You can land either to the east or the west.

76.name: Dead End
76.desc: You have come to a dead end in the mine.

77.name: Timber Room
77.desc:
This is a long and narrow passage, which is cluttered with broken
timbers. A wide passage comes from the east and turns at the
west end of the room into a very narrow passageway. From the west
comes a strong draft.

exits.msg: You cannot fit through this passage with that load.

78.name: Entrance to Hades
78.desc: You are outside a large gateway, on which is inscribed Abandon every hope all ye who enter here! The gate is open; through it you can see a desolation, with a pile of mangled bodies in one corner. Thousands of voices, lamenting some hideous fate, can be heard. The way through the gate is barred by evil spirits, who jeer at your attempts to pass.

exits.msg: Some invisible force prevents you from passing through the gate.
Some invisible force prevents you from passing through the gate.

79.name: Altar
79.desc:
This is the south end of a large temple. In front of you is what
appears to be an altar. In one corner is a small hole in the floor
which leads into darkness. You probably could not get back up it.

exits.msg: You haven't a prayer of getting the coffin down there.

80.name: Temple
80.desc:
This is the north end of a large temple. On the east wall is an
ancient inscription, probably a prayer in a long-forgotten language.
Below the prayer is a staircase leading down. The west wall is solid
granite. The exit to the north end of the room is through huge
marble pillars.

81.name: Frigid River
81.desc:
The sound of rushing water is nearly unbearable here. On the east
shore is a large landing area.

exits.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

82.name: Drafty Room
82.desc:
This is a small drafty room in which is the bottom of a long
shaft. To the south is a passageway and to the east a very narrow
passage. In the shaft can be seen a heavy iron chain.

exits.msg: You cannot fit through this passage with that load.
You cannot fit through this passage with that load.

83.name: Land of the Dead
83.desc:
You have entered the Land of the Living Dead. Thousands of lost souls
can be heard weeping and moaning. In the corner are stacked the remains
of dozens of previous adventurers less fortunate than yourself.
A passage exits to the north.

84.name: Egyptian Room
84.desc:
This is a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb. There is an
ascending staircase to the west.

85.name: Machine Room
85.desc: This is a large, cold room whose sole exit is to the north. In one corner there is a machine which is reminiscent of a clothes dryer. On its face is a switch which is labelled "START". The switch does not appear to be manipulable by any human hand (unless the fingers are about 1/16 by 1/4 inch). On the front of the machine is a large lid, which is open. closed.

86.name: Gallery
86.desc:
This is an art gallery. Most of the paintings have been stolen by
vandals with exceptional taste. The vandals left through either the
north or west exits.

87.name: Frigid River
87.desc:
You are on the Frigid River in the vicinity of the Dam. The river
flows quietly here. There is a landing on the west shore.

exits.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.
The White Cliffs prevent your landing here.

88.name: Frigid River
88.desc:
The river turns a corner here making it impossible to see the
Dam. The White Cliffs loom on the east bank and large rocks prevent
landing on the west.

exits.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.
There is no safe landing spot here.
The White Cliffs prevent your landing here.
Just in time you steer away from the rocks.

89.name: Frigid River
89.desc:
The river descends here into a valley. There is a narrow beach on the
west shore below the cliffs. In the distance a faint rumbling can be
heard.

exits.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

90.name: Sandy Beach
90.desc:
You are on a large sandy beach on the east shore of the river, which is
flowing quickly by. A path runs beside the river to the south here, and
a passage is partially buried in sand to the northeast.

91.name: Sandy Cave
91.desc: This is a sand-filled cave whose exit is to the southwest.
